rationale: Use own colour and zero-based coordinates modulo 3. Zeros on rows congruent to 0 become 8 in columns congruent to 1 or 2; on rows congruent to 2 they become 2 in columns congruent to 1 and 5 in columns congruent to 2. Demonstration 3 shows both repeated bands; nonzero colours remain unchanged.

Use own colour and the row's nonzero colour set. Rows containing only 2 fill zeros with 2, as in demonstration 3. Rows containing {2,3} change 3 to 4, as in demonstration 5. Rows containing {1,2,3} change zeros to 6 and 3 to 8, as in demonstration 4.

Use own colour and the row's nonzero colour set. Zeros become 4 for {1,2}, and 7 for {2} or {1,3}, demonstrated in the first grid. Rows containing {1,2,3} erase 3 to 0, as shown throughout demonstration 3.

Use own colour and zero-based row/column parity. On even rows, odd-column zeros become 4 and odd-column 2 becomes 1; even-column 3 becomes 0. On odd rows, even-column 2 becomes 4. Demonstrations 1 and 3 exhibit these parity-specific changes.

Use own colour and zero-based row/column parity. Even-row odd-column zeros become 2; odd-row even-column zeros become 9 and 2 becomes 6; even-row even-column 3 becomes 1. Demonstration 2 contains every transformation, while other parity classes remain unchanged.

Use own colour and the nearest nonzero colour in each cardinal direction, including absent directions. In demonstration 3, zero at (0,3) becomes 6 with nearest colours down=1, left=2, right=1 and no colour above; zeros at (3,3) and (3,4) become 1 with up=1, left=1 and absent down/right. Coordinates are zero-based.

Use own colour plus both nonzero row and column sets. Demonstration 7 changes 1 to 6 where both sets are {1,2,3}, and changes 2 to 3 where the row set is {1,2,3} and column set is {2,3}. Demonstration 10 changes zero at (0,5) to 6 with row set {1,3} and column set {3}.

Use own colour and nearest nonzero colours up, down, left and right. Demonstration 5 changes zeros at (0,5) and (1,5) to 6: both have down=2, left=2 and absent up/right. Demonstration 8 changes (0,0) to 3 with down=2, right=3 and absent up/left.

Use own colour and zero-based coordinates modulo 3. For zeros, row class 1 and column class 1 maps to 3; row class 2 maps column classes 0,1,2 to 7,9,1 respectively. Demonstration 5 repeats these changes on rows 2 and 5; row class 0 and nonzero colours stay unchanged.

Use own colour and zero-based row/column parity. All 2s on even rows become 0; 1s at even-row even-column positions become 9; zeros at odd-row odd-column positions become 1. Demonstrations 1 and 3 show these changes, with other colour/parity combinations unchanged.
